import sys

def compute_value(n, x):
    numerator = -n * (n * n - 3 * n - 3 * x * x + 9 * x - 4)
    denominator = 2 * (x - 2) * (x - 1) * x
    return numerator / denominator

def main():
    tokens = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    x = int(tokens[0])
    p = float(tokens[1])
    result = 0

    for i in range(x + 1):
        if compute_value(i, x) >= p:
            result = i
            break

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
